ranking_note: Authored from the description at base commit 2ce6729ac9, frozen before any rewrite; protocol per /playbooks:skill-authoring ## Measurement. Sibling kindle-dedrm:setup is in this plugin but user-invoked only (disable-model-invocation true), and manage's own router owns setup routing and status, so state and first-time-setup phrasings are positives here, not near-misses. No other installed plugin covers Kindle DRM removal, so the near-miss negatives (Calibre work without Kindle, Send to Kindle, library ACSM loans, Kindle hardware, Audible, a DRM legality question, firewall and ICACLS rules for other programs) test quietness, not competitor wins. Positives paraphrase the actions rather than repeat the description's quoted phrases.
